subroutines.name: default_start
subroutines.title: *DEFAULT: restore a level file
subroutines.description: Set *TV255 1, MODE 7 and printer off; then, for each level, disable ESCAPE, clear the screen, ask which level to reset and read one or two digits. Accept 1-24, copy that level's original (still encrypted) from the copies at &1DB0 to &6B00 and *SAVE it as LevelN. Then offer another level, or quit through the reset vector. A leading zero (05) is kept in the filename (Level05), which the game does not read.

banners.title: Prompts, the input block and the commands

banners.name: leftovers
banners.title: Leftovers
banners.description: Never used: memory as it lay when the file was saved. A few bytes of text (among them PAGE), the end of an encrypted copy of level 3 and most of one of level 4, laid out with level N at &1000 + N x &2B0, with other bytes written over parts of it, then lines of text reading SEG 0 to SEG 8 and ENDSEG.

banners.name: level_1_original
banners.title: The original levels
banners.description: Levels 1 to 24 as the game loads them: &2B0 bytes each, encrypted (each byte XORed with the low byte of its address at &6B00), identical to the disc's Level1-Level24. *DEFAULT finds level N at &1B00 + N x &2B0.
